purpose: Federation dashboard + model governance UX: replace the CAPSTONE_UI_V1 federation/model placeholders with real CAP-007-backed pages in the existing SvelteKit frontend (successor lock CAPSTONE_UI_V1_1), without any backend, FL, scientific or monitoring change.

ui_successor.rule: every frontend file must be bound by the successor; unaccounted drift fails; the predecessor verifier accepts a changed file only when the successor binds the current bytes

no_backend_change_rule: api/, product/, capstone_persistence/, contracts/, federated/, privacy/, simulation/, src/ are byte-identical to the entry commit; a true incompatibility must STOP and be reported

event_parser.rejects: every monitoring kind, unknown kinds, malformed payloads, foreign run ids
event_parser.sequence: 0,1,2,... per run; gap/duplicate/foreign/malformed => FEDERATION STREAM ERROR, derived state frozen and untrusted
event_parser.reconnect: reset then rebuild from sequence 0 (never append replayed events)
event_parser.progress: only 0 and 1 are rendered; nothing is interpolated

replay_semantics: REPLAY shows a persistent 'REPLAY - NO TRAINING IS EXECUTING' badge; candidate events are labelled HISTORICAL EVENT REPLAY - NO NEW CANDIDATE CREATED and never increment a frontend candidate counter; no-source 409 shows the exact fixed message and never switches to LIVE_RUN
secagg_wording: ROUND-1 PROTECTED-AGGREGATION SHADOW; authoritative aggregate PLAIN; PROTECTED_AGGREGATION_INTERFACE_ONLY; no DP/anonymity/'secure federation' claim
candidate_governance_wording: ACCEPTED TO ENGINEERING SANDBOX REGISTRY / STRUCTURAL CHECKS PASSED / NOT A SCIENTIFIC RELEASE / NOT DEPLOYED / NO CANDIDATE INFERENCE RUNTIME ENABLED; REJECTED BY ENGINEERING GOVERNANCE; production_deployed FALSE always shown; the five checks are structural/engineering only
no_candidate_inference_rule: no candidate state loading, inference API, comparison with MODEL_V2_FINAL, or CAPSTONE_FL_SANDBOX_RUNTIME
offline_mode: DEMO canonical flow works with no Internet; every browser request is same-origin loopback; Clerk is never initialised

canonical_browser_e2e.stack: production CAPSTONE_UI_V1_1 build (vite preview) + headless Chrome with non-loopback hosts blocked + real CAPSTONE_PRODUCT_API_V1_2 DEMO process + fresh SQLite + fresh federation/candidate roots + real training
then: second genuine LIVE_RUN refreshed mid-run (PLAIN; creates CAPSTONE_FL_CANDIDATE_0002 by design)
canonical_browser_e2e.restart_persistence: a third backend process on the same database re-serves the registry

preserved_disclosures: CAP-005 Clerk WebSocket cookie path unverified
CAP-005 accessibility audit not equivalent to formal WCAG certification
CAP-005 canonical UI evidence using ACCELERATED simulation
CAP-007 one-active-run is not a distributed lock
CAP-007 logical clients on one laptop
CAP-007 candidate sandbox has no inference runtime
out_of_scope: held-out evaluation or any candidate metric
chronology_disclosure: The CAP-008 frontend implementation, its unit/component tests and the E2E harness were written before the freeze commit, and the E2E harness was dry-run end to end into a scratch directory outside the repository (twice) to find harness/UI defects (the first dry run exposed horizontal overflow at 390 px and a redundant WebSocket on first load, both fixed before the freeze). None of that output is committed; all recorded canonical results come after the freeze commit.
